spatial_gui.setting.enabled.tooltip: Master switch to render inventory, creative, and container screens as a 3D plane in the world (off by default; check server rules before enabling on multiplayer servers).
spatial_gui.setting.view_mode.tooltip: Third Person swings the camera over your shoulder beside your player model. First Person keeps your normal view.
Flips the third-person camera and floating GUI to the opposite side of your player.
spatial_gui.setting.remove_backdrop.tool: Removes the dark screen tint and background blur so the 3D world behind the GUI stays sharp.
spatial_gui.setting.drop_shadow.tooltip: Draws a subtle floating shadow behind the 3D GUI panel.
spatial_gui.setting.camera_distance.tool: How far behind your player the third-person camera sits (in blocks).
spatial_gui.setting.camera_side_offset.t: Horizontal camera offset in Third Person. Negative puts your player on the left side of the screen.
spatial_gui.setting.camera_height_offset: Vertical height of the third-person camera relative to your player's feet.
spatial_gui.setting.screen_distance.tool: Distance from the third-person camera to the floating 3D GUI plane.
spatial_gui.setting.screen_side_offset.t: Horizontal placement of the 3D GUI in Third Person. Negative shifts the menu to the right.
spatial_gui.setting.screen_height_offset: Vertical placement of the 3D GUI relative to the third-person camera.
spatial_gui.setting.screen_yaw_offset.to: Rotation angle of the 3D GUI in Third Person. 180 faces straight ahead, <180 faces right, >180 faces left toward your player.
spatial_gui.setting.screen_scale.tooltip: World-space size of the floating GUI panel in Third Person.
spatial_gui.setting.transition_ms.toolti: Duration of the smooth camera swing and GUI open/close animation in milliseconds.
spatial_gui.setting.subdivide.tooltip: Splits large UI panels into smaller triangles to prevent perspective texture warping.
spatial_gui.setting.fp_screen_distance.t: Distance in front of your eyes where the 3D GUI floats in First Person mode.
spatial_gui.setting.fp_screen_scale.tool: World-space size of the floating GUI panel in First Person mode.
spatial_gui.setting.fp_screen_yaw_offset: Horizontal tilt angle of the 3D GUI in First Person mode. 180 faces straight at you.
